description: One action with a menu of alternatives at its end, drawn as one control. The primary half runs the action; the caret half opens the menu. Both halves sit in a named group, and each is a tab stop.

content.description: The primary half's label, such as "Deploy". Required, and guarded at runtime: a primary half with no label names no action.

icon.description: Phosphor class name drawn before the label through ArenaIcon. Replaced by the spinner while loading.

destructive.description: Whether the primary action destroys or removes something. Both halves draw the danger outline whatever emphasis the split is given: danger is never filled.

loading.description: Replaces the leading icon with a spinner and blocks the primary half. The caret stays usable, so another action can start while this one runs.

disabled.description: Blocks both halves and dims the control.

type.description: The primary half's native button behaviour. Defaults to 'button' so a split inside a form does not submit it by accident.

label.description: Names the group of both halves, such as "Deployment". Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: a group with no name announces only that a group began.

menuLabel.description: Names the caret half, such as "More deploy options". Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: a caret is a glyph, so this name is all a screen reader hears.

items.description: The menu's entries, in order: activatable rows, dividers and group headers.

align.description: Which edge of the whole split the panel lines up with: start is the primary half's outer edge, end the caret's outer edge.

activate.description: The primary half was activated, by pointer or by keyboard. Never reported while loading or disabled. The native click is never stopped, so a listener on the document hears every click inside the primary half; this event reports only the activation.

select.description: A menu entry was activated; carries the whole item. A disabled entry reports nothing, and a divider or a header cannot be activated at all.
